page.layout: One scan: the spine of a bound book in dark leather with raised bands, plus a white library label at the lower part. No printed page is visible; the label is a library stamp and is left out.
page.notes: Scan shows the leather spine of a book (decorative bands, worn gilt tooling, a red-brown leather label area at the top) and a white library label reading "Su 4522". The label is a shelf mark and is not transcribed. No printed text from the book is visible, so the page is empty.
